Two of Cookie's four food groups.How to make it400g dried navy beans150g bacon, diced1 brown onion3 tbsp molasses1 tbsp Dijon mustardSoak the beans overnight.Soak.Simmer the beans in fresh water until tender.Fry the bacon with the chopped onion, then stir in the beans, molasses, mustard and water to cover.Simmer until thick and smoky.Serve in tin cups.Vinny's office supply cheese, salami and cracker tinsCheddar cubes, salami, water crackers and pickled onions in small tinsHow to make it1 box water crackers200g cheddar150g salami1 jar pickled onionsCube the cheddar and slice the salami.Pack small tins with crackers, cheese, salami and pickled onions.Close the lids and hand them out.MainsLime grilled fish with mango salsaWhite fish with lime and garlic, mango chilli salsa, jasmine riceHow to make it4 white fish fillets3 limes3 garlic cloves2 mangoes1 red chilli1/2 red onion300g jasmine rice400ml coconut milksalt, to tasteRub the fish with lime juice, crushed garlic and salt.Dice the mango, chilli and red onion and mix with lime juice for salsa.Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.Grill the fish until just cooked.Serve the fish on the rice with the salsa.Cookie's campfire chilli and cornbreadCookie calls it Caesar salad, escargot and spring rollsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread from a cast iron pan.Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches.Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder.Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours.Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake in a hot cast iron pan at 220°C for 20 minutes.SweetsHeart of Atlantis pavlovaMeringue topped with passionfruit.DrinksCookie's condensed milk iced coffeeStrong plunger coffee over ice with sweetened condensed milkHow to make it500ml strong coffee8 tbsp sweetened condensed milk1 bag ice1 pinch ground cinnamonBrew strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot.Cool for 10 minutes.Put condensed milk in four tin mugs, fill with ice and pour the coffee over.Stir well and finish with cinnamon.
